section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Digital Infrastructure Landlord Re-Rating ($6.6B Meta Lease) vs. Near-Term Bitcoin Mining Cash Burn
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Bears and short-sellers (42.89% short float) highlight that Q3 FY26 mining gross margin collapsed to 17.9%, OCF burned -$112.33M, and Sandersville does not begin generating rent until November 30, 2027—leaving a 12-month cash bridge risk.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: CleanSpark's $2.276B senior secured project notes (closed Sep 2026) ring-fence Sandersville construction capex at the subsidiary level, while $814.9M in BTC + $202.6M cash provides ~$1B in liquidity buffer against $6.6B of investment-grade Meta NNN cash flows (~$330M/yr NOI).
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Gary Vecchiarelli: Following the $2.276B project-level debt closing in September, what is CleanSpark's pro-forma parent-level unrestricted cash and BTC treasury balance, and how much mining OCF is needed to avoid any common equity ATM issuance through Q4 2027?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Texas 885 MW Portfolio Conversion: Binding Second Hyperscale Lease or Stranded Mining Capacity?
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Skeptics note that CleanSpark discontinued standalone monthly mining updates starting FY27 and has not yet converted the Texas 885 MW Meta LOI/exclusivity into a definitive binding lease, raising questions over ERCOT interconnection timelines.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Discontinuing monthly BTC production releases aligns CleanSpark with institutional data center peers (CORZ, EQIX, DLR) rather than retail crypto miners, while Texas's 885 MW grid-connected footprint represents an additional ~$15B+ contracted revenue opportunity if converted at Sandersville economics.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Matt Schultz: Can you detail the engineering and ERCOT interconnection milestones for the 885 MW Texas portfolio under exclusivity, and should investors expect a binding Texas Phase-1 AI/HPC lease announcement within the next two quarters?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Extreme Valuation Dislocation (4.18x EV/Sales, $5.64 Spot vs. $20.87 Mean PT) & 42.89% Short Squeeze Setup
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Quant/momentum funds (e.g., Zacks Sell rating) remain short CLSK due to four consecutive GAAP EPS misses, rising total debt ($1.79B corporate + $2.28B project), and -42.9% YoY Q4 revenue contraction.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: At $1.45B Market Cap ($5.64/sh), the market values CleanSpark at a fraction of its $6.6B contracted Meta lease NPV (~$330M annual NNN NOI at ~100% margin) plus ~$815M BTC holdings, creating extreme asymmetry vs 13.4x–18.4x EV/Sales peers (CORZ, IREN) if execution stays on schedule.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Management: With Sandersville generating ~$330M in projected annual NNN NOI starting late 2027 versus a $1.45B current equity market cap, how do you evaluate non-dilutive project equity partnerships or convertible refinancing to bridge the valuation gap?
